# Signal Audit

> Signal Audit provides practical website diagnostics for Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and AI search readiness.

## What it does
- Checks public homepage HTML for technical signals including title, meta description, H1 structure, canonical link, JSON-LD presence, indexing directives, image alt attributes, and document language.
- Checks whether standard public files such as robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and llms.txt are reachable.
- Provides a free homepage snapshot and printable findings.
- Focuses on actionable technical observations rather than guaranteed rankings or AI citations.

## Important limitations
- A technical readiness scan does not query ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, or other answer engines.
- Detection of structured data does not confirm that the schema is valid.
- Presence or absence of llms.txt is not a confirmed ranking factor.
- No ranking, citation, or revenue outcome is guaranteed.

## Website
- Homepage: https://chatgptplayground.vercel.app/
- Free homepage audit: https://chatgptplayground.vercel.app/#free-check
